questions.question: What is the main truth taught in this passage?
questions.answer: Allah is perfect, and He has no partners.

questions.question: What things in the world show that there are real perfections?
questions.answer: Wisdom, beauty, fairness, and good purposes show it.

questions.question: Whose perfections are shown by the universe?
questions.answer: The Creator’s perfections are shown.

questions.question: How was the universe brought into being?
questions.answer: Allah made it from nothing.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the way the Creator takes care of the universe?
questions.answer: He runs it in a wonderful and beautiful way.

questions.question: What does the passage say about human beings?
questions.answer: People are a knowing mirror that shows signs of the Creator.

questions.question: Why are human perfections important in the passage?
questions.answer: They show that people have a special place in creation.

questions.question: What special job of man is mentioned?
questions.answer: Man is Allah’s deputy on earth.

questions.question: What would be wrong about giving partners to Allah?
questions.answer: It would go against all these perfections.

questions.question: What would happen to the wise and beautiful beings we see if people believed in partners with Allah?
questions.answer: Their value and meaning would be ruined.

questions.question: If Allah had partners, what would the universe become in that false idea?
questions.answer: It would seem like a pointless place with no true wisdom.

questions.question: What would happen to living things in that false idea?
questions.answer: Their world would seem harsh and full of suffering.

questions.question: What would happen to thinking and feeling people in that false idea?
questions.answer: Life would seem very sad and heavy for them.

questions.question: In that false belief, how would man be lowered?
questions.answer: Man would be pushed down to a very low level.

questions.question: What would be hidden if people assigned partners to Allah?
questions.answer: The endless perfections of the Creator would be covered up.

questions.question: Which truth is explained in this passage?
questions.answer: The truth of perfections.

questions.question: Where can we see signs of these perfections?
questions.answer: We can see them in the universe and in people.

questions.question: Name two things in the universe that point to perfection.
questions.answer: Beautiful order and wise purposes.

questions.question: What do just laws in the universe show?
questions.answer: They show that creation is made with fairness and wisdom.

questions.question: What do these signs tell us about the Creator?
questions.answer: The Creator Himself must be perfect.

questions.question: Why must the Maker be perfect if His creation is perfect?
questions.answer: Because perfect works point to a perfect Maker.

questions.question: Which creature is called the most important fruit of the universe?
questions.answer: Man.

questions.question: How does the passage show that man is honored?
questions.answer: It says man is beloved, valued, and given a special duty.

questions.question: What false idea does the passage strongly reject?
questions.answer: The idea of making partners with Allah.

questions.question: Why does that false idea not fit with divine perfection?
questions.answer: It denies the Creator’s full greatness and perfect work.

questions.question: Why does that false idea not fit with human perfection?
questions.answer: It drags people down and removes their honor.

questions.question: Why does that false idea not fit with the universe?
questions.answer: It makes the whole world seem meaningless and random.

questions.question: What feeling about the world would come from that false belief?
questions.answer: The world would seem sad, cruel, and without true purpose.

questions.question: What happens to the signs that reflect the Creator if people believe He has partners?
questions.answer: Those signs are hidden and their message is spoiled.

questions.question: What does the passage say all the wisdom and beauty in the universe do?
questions.answer: They give clear proof of real perfection.

questions.question: Are these signs hard to notice or easy to notice in the passage?
questions.answer: They are easy to notice.

questions.question: Besides the universe, what else gives testimony in the passage?
questions.answer: Human beings do.

questions.question: In what way do people give testimony?
questions.answer: Their special qualities show signs of the Creator’s perfection.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the Creator and the cosmos?
questions.answer: The Creator made the cosmos in a perfect way.

questions.question: What can we infer about a maker from a well-made creation?
questions.answer: The maker is not careless but excellent.

questions.question: Why is man called a mirror in the passage?
questions.answer: Because man reflects signs of the Creator.

questions.question: What do the words about man being loved and valued show?
questions.answer: They show that man has great worth.

questions.question: What is the result if someone says Allah has partners?
questions.answer: That person destroys the meaning of perfection.

questions.question: What would happen to the order and wisdom we see around us in that wrong belief?
questions.answer: They would seem lost and pointless.

questions.question: What would the universe look like if it were only an accident?
questions.answer: It would look random and without purpose.

questions.question: What would happen to the honor of man in that wrong idea?
questions.answer: His honor would be taken away.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the effect on living creatures in that false view?
questions.answer: Their world would seem like a place of harm and loss.

questions.question: What is covered when Allah’s endless perfections are not accepted properly?
questions.answer: The clear reflection of His greatness in creation is covered.

questions.question: Does the passage support tawhid or shirk?
questions.answer: It supports tawhid.

questions.question: What important idea about Allah is proven in this passage?
questions.answer: Allah has perfect qualities.

questions.question: What in the universe helps prove this idea?
questions.answer: Its wisdom, beauty, justice, and purpose.

questions.question: What does making the universe from nothing show?
questions.answer: It shows the Creator’s great power and perfection.

questions.question: What does caring for the universe in a wonderful way show?
questions.answer: It shows wise and beautiful control.

questions.question: What role does man have in showing the Creator’s signs?
questions.answer: Man shows them like a mirror.

questions.question: Why is man called the most important fruit of the universe?
questions.answer: Because man has special value and awareness.

questions.question: What is one reason the passage gives for rejecting partners with Allah?
questions.answer: Partners would ruin the meaning of all perfection.

questions.question: According to the passage, what would happen to all the perfect beings we see?
questions.answer: They would seem destroyed in meaning and worth.

questions.question: How would the universe be misunderstood if shirk were true?
questions.answer: It would be seen as a useless game of chance.

questions.question: How would nature be wrongly viewed in that case?
questions.answer: It would be treated as if it worked on its own in a blind way.

questions.question: How would animals and other living beings be affected in that false picture?
questions.answer: Their world would seem cruel.

questions.question: How would conscious people feel in that false picture?
questions.answer: They would seem trapped in deep sadness.

questions.question: What would happen to man’s high rank?
questions.answer: It would be lowered badly.

questions.question: What would happen to the Creator’s endless perfect qualities?
questions.answer: Their reflection would be hidden.

questions.question: What connection does the passage make between perfection and Allah’s oneness?
questions.answer: Real perfection points to one perfect Creator.

questions.question: What truth is the passage focusing on?
questions.answer: The truth of perfections.

questions.question: What are some clues of perfection in the world around us?
questions.answer: Wise design, lovely beauty, fair rules, and good goals.

questions.question: What do these clues teach us about the One who made everything?
questions.answer: He must be perfect.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the making of the cosmos?
questions.answer: It was made by the Creator from nothing.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the running of the cosmos?
questions.answer: It is managed in a marvelous and beautiful way.

questions.question: Who is described as a conscious mirror?
questions.answer: Man.

questions.question: What does being a conscious mirror mean in a simple way?
questions.answer: People can notice and reflect signs of Allah’s work.

questions.question: How is man honored in the passage?
questions.answer: Man is called very important, loved, and precious.

questions.question: What belief is called false and unacceptable?
questions.answer: Giving Allah partners.

questions.question: Why is that belief false according to this passage?
questions.answer: It fights against the perfection seen in Allah’s creation.

questions.question: What would happen to the universe’s meaning if that false belief were accepted?
questions.answer: Its meaning would fall apart.

questions.question: What would happen to the idea of wisdom in creation?
questions.answer: Wisdom would be denied.

questions.question: What would happen to man’s visible good qualities and works?
questions.answer: They would be pushed down and lose their true value.

questions.question: What happens to the Creator’s reflected perfections in shirk?
questions.answer: They are blocked from being seen clearly.

questions.question: What does the passage say is very clear in the universe?
questions.answer: Signs of perfection are very clear.

questions.question: Which parts of creation especially show these signs?
questions.answer: Its wisdom, beauty, justice, and purpose show them.

questions.question: What do these signs say about the Creator?
questions.answer: They show that the Creator is perfect.

questions.question: What two big things are spoken about as having perfections?
questions.answer: The Creator and man.

questions.question: Why is man mentioned with honor in the passage?
questions.answer: Because man is special in creation and reflects signs of the Creator.

questions.question: What title for man shows a special duty on earth?
questions.answer: Allah’s deputy on earth.

questions.question: If someone claimed Allah had partners, what would that do to the meaning of creation?
questions.answer: It would spoil its meaning.

questions.question: What would happen to the wonderful and wise beings we can see?
questions.answer: Their worth would seem wasted.

questions.question: In that wrong belief, how would the world be wrongly pictured?
questions.answer: As random and without true purpose.

questions.question: How would living creatures be wrongly pictured?
questions.answer: As if they were in a harsh place with no mercy.

questions.question: How would people be wrongly pictured?
questions.answer: As low and miserable instead of honored.

questions.question: What would happen to the signs that point to Allah’s endless perfection?
questions.answer: They would be hidden behind a veil.

questions.question: Why is assigning partners to Allah against cosmic perfection?
questions.answer: Because the whole universe points to one perfect Maker.

questions.question: Why is it against human perfection?
questions.answer: Because it takes away man’s high value.

questions.question: Why is it against Divine perfection?
questions.answer: Because it denies the Creator’s complete greatness.
